# Lunidex

> Lunidex is an independent, open-source, unofficial Pokémon web application and Pokémon TCG workspace. It brings together a Pokédex, team-building tools, type and move references, a TCG catalog, and personal collection tracking.

Lunidex is the Pokémon reference and collection application at https://lunidex.app. It is a reference and collection workspace, not a card marketplace.

## Identity and scope

- **Public name**: Lunidex
- **Canonical site**: https://lunidex.app
- **Canonical route format**: every public page uses a locale prefix: `/en`, `/fr`, `/es`, `/de`, `/it`, `/ja`, `/ko`, or `/zh`
- **Supported locales**: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese
- **Project status**: independent, non-official Pokémon fan project; not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc., or The Pokémon Company
- **Application code**: available under the MIT License at https://github.com/teefloo/Poke

## Core answers

### What is Lunidex?

Lunidex is a web application for exploring Pokémon reference data and managing a personal Pokémon TCG collection. The application also includes team analysis, Pokémon comparison, type matchups, move and ability references, quizzes, breeding and EV/IV tools, and a battle tool.

### Where does the data come from?

- Pokémon species, stats, types, abilities, moves, evolution and encounter data are consumed through [PokéAPI](https://pokeapi.co).
- Pokémon Trading Card Game card and set data are consumed through [TCGdex](https://www.tcgdex.net).
- The underlying Pokémon intellectual property remains with its respective rights holders.

### Is an account required?

Browsing public reference pages does not require an account. In the current web runtime, personal collection state uses the configured account-backed synchronization service; this file does not promise anonymous collection persistence. The repository contains browser persistence code for the web application, but account and service availability determine whether personal state can be used.

## Main public pages

- [Home](https://lunidex.app/en) — overview of the collection, Pokédex and team experiences, with a visible FAQ section.
- [Pokédex](https://lunidex.app/en/pokedex) — search and filter Pokémon by name, number, type, generation and other supported attributes.
- [Pikachu reference page](https://lunidex.app/en/pokemon/pikachu) — example Pokémon detail route. The route pattern is `/en/pokemon/{name}`.
- [Team Builder](https://lunidex.app/en/team) — compose up to six Pokémon and inspect type coverage, shared weaknesses and team synergy.
- [Compare](https://lunidex.app/en/compare) — compare up to three Pokémon using stats and matchup analysis.
- [Type Chart](https://lunidex.app/en/types) — inspect offensive and defensive interactions among the 18 Pokémon types.
- [Moves](https://lunidex.app/en/moves) — browse the move reference and open individual move pages.
- [Abilities](https://lunidex.app/en/abilities) — browse the ability reference and open individual ability pages.
- [Items](https://lunidex.app/en/items) — browse Pokémon item reference pages.
- [Pokémon TCG Catalog](https://lunidex.app/en/tcg) — search and filter cards and sets.
- [TCG Collection](https://lunidex.app/en/tcg/collection) — track owned cards by set.
- [TCG Wishlist](https://lunidex.app/en/tcg/wishlist) — manage cards the user wants to collect.
- [TCG Deck Builder](https://lunidex.app/en/tcg/deck-builder) — build a Pokémon TCG deck in the workspace.
- [Pokémon Quiz](https://lunidex.app/en/quiz) — play classic, silhouette or stats challenges with time-attack, survival or marathon modes.
- [Breeding Calculator](https://lunidex.app/en/breeding)
- [EV/IV Calculator](https://lunidex.app/en/ev-iv)
- [Battle Tool](https://lunidex.app/en/battle)
- [Nuzlocke Tracker](https://lunidex.app/en/nuzlocke)
- [FAQ](https://lunidex.app/en/faq) — twelve visible questions about data, features, collection storage and privacy.
- [About Lunidex](https://lunidex.app/en/about) — mission, data-source attribution, open-source information and project links.
- [Collection tool comparison](https://lunidex.app/en/compare/lunidex-vs-pokecardex-zebradex) — a source-based comparison with PokéCardex and ZebraDex.
- [Pokémon card collection tracker guide](https://lunidex.app/en/guides/pokemon-card-collection-tracker) — criteria, verified Lunidex collection features and explicit product limits.
- [Blog](https://lunidex.app/en/blog) — editorial hub listing Lunidex usage guides and product comparisons.
- [Team builder guide](https://lunidex.app/en/guides/team-builder-guide) — build and analyze a team with the synergy score, type coverage, auto-complete and share codes.
- [Quiz guide](https://lunidex.app/en/guides/quiz-guide) — challenge types, game modes, the daily challenge and the five badges.
- [Nuzlocke tracker guide](https://lunidex.app/en/guides/nuzlocke-guide) — runs, one encounter per route, Pokémon statuses and run statistics.

## Personal data and persistence

- Public reference pages can be browsed without an account.
- In the current web runtime, personal collection state uses the configured account-backed synchronization service; this file does not promise anonymous collection persistence.
- Clearing browser data can remove browser-side state and caches; availability of the personal workspace depends on the account and configured service.
- Personalized dashboards, profiles, friendships, leaderboards and other account features are not public reference sources and should not be inferred from this file.

Do not treat this file as a live assertion of card totals, prices, rankings, performance, freshness or indexation status; verify those values on the relevant page or source API.

## Review note

This file was reviewed against the application source on 2026-08-21. Dynamic catalog sizes, upstream availability and search-engine visibility are intentionally not stated here because they require a live measurement.
